input.objective:
Publish the redesigned Weir website to the site label weir (https://weir.sites.imd.fun, ENS weir.site.identitymd.eth), replacing the version served there now, so that the site works with the Weir v2 contract this project deployed (launch 1869, contract 0xde049547f1e55bb093e14d8f4545d1cc9b613f97 on Robinhood Chain 4663). The site is already built and approved by the owner: do NOT redesign, restyle, rewrite copy, rename or add features. This job only imports the finished site and publishes it.

SOURCE. The public repository https://github.com/SwarmStream/weir at commit bf5fa02392c5c0fd1f7bb4b29ade63396025414b holds the Weir front end: Vite + React + wagmi source in web/ and the finished static export in dist/. Replace this project's front end with that repository's web/ and dist/. dist/ is what gets published, exactly as committed; do not rebuild it, recompress any image, or change any file name.

THE DEPLOYMENT FILE. dist/imd-deployment.json lists two contracts on chain 4663: the existing WEIR token 0x58b82fa656ecf47a0dca5be6bad06b92e22f7dbe (from the earlier Weir launch, launch 1780) and the new Weir v2 contract 0xde049547f1e55bb093e14d8f4545d1cc9b613f97 (from this project's launch 1869, source commit 108660578606392f284fe2ad19bd8b576ece0bae, attestation 87f6b46bf48f07b1406efa6bcd83c8c18794c031c5797841a282bbdf60543582). Leave this file, dist/abi/ and all addresses exactly as committed. If the platform cannot publish a site whose deployment file names a contract from another launch, say so plainly in the result and publish nothing else.

HARD RULES. The product name is written exactly "Weir." with the period. Leave all contract calls and wallet flows as they are. Do not claim an audit beyond the swarm's panel. The published site must load its index page, serve its fonts and images from the site itself, and load no external script, analytics or tracker. It must work at 360 px wide with no horizontal page scroll (the home page street pans sideways inside its own frame on phones by design).

acceptanceCriteria: dist/ from SwarmStream/weir at the stated commit is published unchanged
dist/imd-deployment.json and dist/abi/ are exactly as committed
No third-party script, font host, analytics or tracker is loaded
The site is published at the label weir
